title: Solitude in Peaks
description: A lone hiker stands atop a misty mountain peak in the Alps.
technique: Wide-angle lens (24mm), f/8 for deep depth of field, captured in early morning low light.

title: Urban Echoes
description: The late night neon lights of Tokyo reflecting in the rain.
technique: Low aperture (f/1.8) to capture reflections and light trails. High ISO for low light city life.

title: Gaze of Time
description: A portrait capturing the wisdom of an elderly artisan.
technique: Natural lighting, shallow depth of field (f/1.2) to emphasize the eyes.

title: Desert Mirage
description: Vast dunes of the Sahara at golden hour.
technique: Golden hour lighting, tracking shot with gimbal for smooth movement.
gear: DJI Mavic 3 Pro (Aerial), Canon EOS R5 (Ground)

title: Emerald Forest
description: Deep morning light filtering through ancient Redwoods.
technique: Long exposure to soften light, CPL filter to reduce reflections on leaves.

title: Hidden Alley
description: A narrow cobblestone street in Florence.
technique: Vertical framing to emphasize height, mid-day light with high contrast.
